name: forgeloop
description: Tracker-driven engineering workflows with Specs, Tickets, one-time dual review, accountable delivery, and final gates.

interface.shortDescription: Design and deliver Tracker work with one accountable worker and one-time review
interface.longDescription: A Tracker-driven Codex workflow suite for repository setup, design discovery, Spec and Ticket publication, large-Ticket and Spec delivery by one accountable worker, one-time independent Spec and Standards review, final gates, integration, and recovery.
defaultPrompt: 使用 Forgeloop 配置当前仓库的 Tracker、领域文档与集成策略。
使用 Forgeloop 将当前讨论发布为 Spec，并拆成可独立验证的 Tickets。
使用 Forgeloop 由一个 Delivery Worker 从大 Ticket、正式 Spec 或有界 Initiative 完成一次性双轴审查与最终 Gate。
